pair_sum_is_tautological.why: NO_bid = 1 - YES_ask and NO_ask = 1 - YES_bid (Polymarket design), therefore mid(NO) = 1 - mid(YES) identically and mid(A)+mid(B) == 1 to float precision. check2_pairing / audit.py 'pair sum~1' / HANDOVER.md:24 'pair-sums-to-1' carry no information.
